purpose: Sanitized relationship reconciliation and source-attribution policy. Only durable user-approved relationship names belong here; unresolved third-party identities, raw messages, contact data, and uncertain identity evidence remain local/private.

partner.rule: Newest direct user wording controls the current relationship label; household evidence does not establish Olivia's individual preferences.

family.sibling_structure: User is the oldest of five siblings.
family.rule: Keep individual sibling identities and private family dynamics local unless a task explicitly requires them.

source_attribution_policy.profile_promotion_default: Direct personal-profile promotion requires both user/user_confirmed authorship and user/user_confirmed subject attribution, unless the user explicitly confirms the candidate.
source_attribution_policy.mixed_archive_rule: Organizational mail/PST archives must resolve message actor and subject before creating personal-profile candidates.
source_attribution_policy.same_name_rule: Name equality alone never merges people.
source_attribution_policy.subject_not_equal_actor: Authorship and subject identity are separate. A user-authored message about an applicant, coworker, family member, or organization is not autobiographical evidence.

quarantined_or_unresolved.reason: Conflicts with stronger/current biography and is plausibly attributable to another user of the shared ChatGPT account.
Single historical account-authored claim with unresolved actor attribution and no corroborated completion/current enrollment.
quarantined_or_unresolved.promotion_rule: Requires actor attribution or newer direct user confirmation.

unresolved_identity_candidates.label: Named social-contact candidate
unresolved_identity_candidates.reason: A recurring imported social identity exists, but closeness/current relationship and safe canonical relevance are unresolved. Keep the actual identity local.

unresolved_identity_candidates.label: Unidentified recurring friend candidate
unresolved_identity_candidates.reason: Recurring friend/photo context exists without a reliable identity. Keep any source-level identifying details local.

unresolved_identity_candidates.label: Workplace same-name collision candidate
unresolved_identity_candidates.reason: A workplace identity shares a name with a durable personal relationship. Do not merge by name; keep the work identity local until independently resolved.

unresolved_identity_candidates.label: Cross-context work-contact candidate
unresolved_identity_candidates.reason: A named work contact appears across multiple work contexts; organization/time evidence must establish continuity. Keep the name and raw evidence local.

unresolved_identity_candidates.label: Historical/current work-name collision candidate
unresolved_identity_candidates.reason: Current work and historical organizational-archive references may refer to different people. Keep source identities local and require temporal/organization evidence.

provenance.note: Built from previously ingested personal mail/profile/conversation evidence; uncertain third-party links remain non-canonical candidates.
